info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Reopens-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Reopening API allows users to retrieve a list of support tickets that have been marked for reopening. This functionality is essential for support teams to effectively manage and review tickets that may require further attention. Typical consumers include customer support representatives and administrators who need to track customer issues. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their response strategies and improve customer satisfaction by ensuring no critical issues are overlooked.

get.description: This operation allows users to reopen a previously closed ticket, enabling them to continue discussions or requests related to that ticket. Make sure the ticket is eligible to be reopened based on your organization's policies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to reopen a previously closed ticket. It should specify the necessary details for identifying the ticket that needs to be reopened.

204.description: The request was successfully processed, but there is no content to return.

ListSupportTicketsReopensRequest.description: This schema represents the request body as a string for the reopen operations related to tickets.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the re-opening operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket after the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information regarding the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_204.description: Response schema for the ticket re-opening operation which indicates the result of the operation.

createdBy.description: User or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit trail of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request.
